errors.planRequired: Products with variants are part of the Pro and Premium plans. Upgrade to create or edit them.
errors.noPermission: Your user doesn't have permission to do this. Ask whoever manages the business.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet and try again.

variante.aviso: “{{name}}” is a variant of “{{familia}}”. The name, category, photo, add-ons, printer and SAT keys are changed in “{{familia}}”. Here you change its price, SKU, barcode and stock.
variante.extrasDesde: Add-ons for “{{familia}}” are changed in that product

alta.casillaAyuda: For example a T-shirt in several sizes and colors, or a coffee in small, medium and large. Each combination has its own price, SKU and stock.
alta.seccionAyuda: Type the options and their values. Avoqado builds the combinations; untick the ones you don't sell.

opciones.nombreEjemplo: For example: Size, Color or Volume
opciones.valoresEjemplo: Type a value and press Enter (S, M, L…)

validacion.sinOpciones: Add at least one option, for example “Size”.
validacion.demasiadasOpciones: A product can have up to 3 options (for example size, color and material).
validacion.demasiadasCombinaciones: That makes {{count}} combinations; the maximum is 250. Remove some values or options.
validacion.precioInvalido: The price of “{{nombre}}” must be greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals.
validacion.costoInvalido: The cost of “{{nombre}}” must be greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals (leave it empty if you don't know it).
validacion.skuInvalido: The SKU of “{{nombre}}” can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
validacion.codigoLargo: The barcode of “{{nombre}}” is longer than 14 digits.
validacion.existenciasInvalidas: The initial stock of “{{nombre}}” must be a whole number.

biblioteca.ayuda: Save options like “Size” or “Color” to reuse them when you create products with variants. Changing an option here doesn't change the products that already used it.
biblioteca.borrarConfirmar: The template “{{name}}” will be deleted. Products that already use it won't change.
biblioteca.vacia: You don't have any saved options yet. Create “Size”, “Color” or “Volume” to reuse them.
biblioteca.error: Your saved options couldn't be loaded.
biblioteca.truncada: This option has {{count}} values; only options with up to 100 values can be edited from here.
biblioteca.sinPermiso: You can view this option but not change it. Ask whoever manages the business for permission.
biblioteca.vaciaSoloLectura: There are no saved options yet. Whoever manages the business can create them here.

picker.error: Your saved options couldn't be loaded.
picker.vacia: You don't have any saved options yet. You can create them in Menu › Options.
picker.truncada: {{total}} values; only the first 100 are used

familia.errorAlReleer: What you see couldn't be refreshed; what you typed is still here.
familia.noExiste: That product with variants no longer exists.
familia.archivada: This product with variants is archived: you can view it, but not edit it.
familia.avisoPlan: Changing the shared details or adding variants requires the Pro plan. You can still change each variant's prices and codes.

padre.ayuda_one: Whatever you change here is copied to the variant.
padre.ayuda_other: Whatever you change here is copied to the {{count}} variants.
padre.sinExtras: This business has no modifier groups.

variantesTabla.ayudaPrecio: Price, cost and codes belong to each variant.

problema.precioInvalido: The price must be greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals.
problema.costoInvalido: The cost must be greater than 0 (or leave it empty).
problema.skuInvalido: The SKU can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
problema.codigoLargo: The barcode is longer than 14 digits.

crecer.ayuda: Type new values (for example “XL”) or a new option (for example “Material”). Combinations of existing values that were never created show up with “Show missing combinations”.
crecer.paraExistentes_one: Which value does the existing variant take?
crecer.paraExistentes_other: Which value do the {{count}} existing variants take?
crecer.guardado: Done: the new options were saved.
crecer.sinCambios: Type at least one new value or option.
crecer.valorParaExistentes: Choose, among the new option's values, the one the existing variants take.
crecer.faltantesDemasiadas_one: There is {{count}} uncreated combination that doesn't fit here; add new values or create it a few at a time.
crecer.faltantesDemasiadas_other: There are {{count}} uncreated combinations; add new values or create the ones you need a few at a time.
crecer.noCaben_one: That is {{count}} new variant, but this product already has {{vivas}} and the maximum is 250: {{caben}} more fit.
crecer.noCaben_other: That makes {{count}} new variants, but this product already has {{vivas}} and the maximum is 250: {{caben}} more fit. Remove some values or options.
crecer.marcadasDeMas_one: You checked {{count}} new variant, but this product already has {{vivas}} and the maximum is 250: {{caben}} more fit.
crecer.marcadasDeMas_other: You checked {{count}} new variants, but this product already has {{vivas}} and the maximum is 250: {{caben}} more fit. Uncheck some or remove values.
crecer.existenciasDespues: Some variants of this product track inventory and others don't: enter the new ones' stock later, on each variant.

valores.renombrado: Value renamed; its variants' names were updated.

archivadas.ayuda: To sell an archived variant again, import it with its SKU from Import menu.

accionesVariante.separarConfirmar: “{{name}}” becomes a standalone product, keeping its name, price and stock.
accionesVariante.archivarConfirmar: “{{name}}” stops being sold. Its past sales don't change.

accionesFamilia.deshacerConfirmar_one: The variant becomes a standalone product, keeping its name, price, SKU and stock. “{{name}}” is archived.
accionesFamilia.deshacerConfirmar_other: The {{count}} variants become standalone products, keeping their name, price, SKU and stock. “{{name}}” is archived.
accionesFamilia.archivarConfirmar_one: “{{name}}” and its variant stop being sold. Their past sales don't change.
accionesFamilia.archivarConfirmar_other: “{{name}}” and its {{count}} variants stop being sold. Their past sales don't change.
